comment: Source read at commit 5458029, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.2.0. THE TOP QUARTER OF THE WAVEFORM KNOB IS INERT: FM3HR.cpp:56 calls Square(Phase, 0.5 - (Wave - 3) * 0.45, sqramnt) and Square() at line 116 is 'return blep;', so the pulse-width argument it computes is discarded and every setting from three to four gives the same square. Two more maker slips found in the same file and left out of the lines: the minBLEP branch at lines 31 to 35 tests 'WaveAmount <= 2' twice, so the second branch can never run and the saw gets no band-limiting; and parameter 3 is configured with the name 'Coarse CV Amount' at line 171 when it is the fine CV amount. The COARSE knob is passed through round() only when the 1V/OCT jack is connected (line 228), so it is continuous with nothing patched there and stepped in octaves with a cable in.
